summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch and rights-dependent monetization; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: SearchWoot remains private; Woot documentation shows API access but not public/commercial redistribution rights, while public terms restrict listing, price, derivative, and data-mining uses. All 4 launch-readiness legal tasks remain open. Accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked. Compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown; data quality is yellow for analytics and aggregate revenue attribution. Revenue is $4.92 aggregate for 2026-09-21 and cannot be assigned to a site. Exact decision: keep the private gate, do not send Woot outreach, expand alerts, enable monetization, deploy, or change tracking. Progress: 0/4 tasks closed; no task is closable on current evidence. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, data-flow and retention table, consent/GA4 configuration capture, and logs/vendor/incident inventory, then route unresolved rights and jurisdictional privacy questions to human counsel.

Launch-readiness data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data—counsel_required; missing written permission/API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed; missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository/deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics—evidence_needed; missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed; missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Site and fleet triage: ordinary growth is not blocked merely by incomplete telemetry, but failed or unknown compliance sites require remediation or evidence before exposure or monetization. The private/gated SearchWoot decision is explicit: retain private status until rights, privacy, accuracy, measurement, security, and owner gates are complete. Parked or scaffold sites remain parked unless a concrete readiness checklist and owner disposition exist. Do not infer adult, regulated, or age-sensitive status from domain names; escalate any supported age-sensitive, regulated, claims, copyright, trademark, or platform-policy issue when evidenced.
